coconut-001.name: Scar - Finally King
coconut-001.text: During your turn, you pay 1 {I} less for the first Ally character you play.

coconut-002.name: Ariel - Spectacular Singer
coconut-002.text: Whenever a Princess character of yours sings a song, gain lore equal to her {L}.

coconut-003.name: Winnie the Pooh - Hunny Wizard
coconut-003.text: Whenever you play a character without an ability, you may pay 1 {I} to draw a card.

coconut-004.name: Stitch - Rock Star
coconut-004.text: Once during your turn, you may play a character with cost 2 or less for free. If that character was named Lilo or Stitch, chosen character gets +1 {L} this turn.

coconut-005.name: Ursula - Deceiver of All
coconut-005.text: Your characters count as having +1 cost for singing songs. Your characters named Ursula count as having +2 cost instead.

coconut-006.name: Mickey Mouse - Brave Little Tailor
coconut-006.text: Mickey Mouse character cards in your hand, deck, and discard gain Shift 2 {I}.

coconut-007.name: Mufasa - Ruler of Pride Rock
coconut-007.text: Once during your turn, you may pay 5 {I} to put the top 2 cards of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

coconut-008.name: Nick Wilde - Wily Fox
coconut-008.text: You can have up to 4 copies of an item card named Pawpsicle in your deck.\n\nOnce during your turn, you may banish 4 of your items. If you do, gain 4 lore.

coconut-009.name: Snow White - Merry as the Morning
coconut-009.text: Once per game during your turn, you may reveal your hand. If you have a Snow White and 7 or more Seven Dwarfs character cards with different names among the cards in your hand, in your discard, and in play, your characters get +2 {L} for the rest of the game.
coconut-009.associated_card: Snow White - Merry as the Morning

coconut-010.name: Donald Duck - Fred Honeywell
coconut-010.text: You pay 1 {I} less to use Boost abilities and to play characters or locations with Boost.

coconut-011.name: Mr. Incredible - Super Strong
coconut-011.text: Whenever you play a Super character, they gain Rush this turn and you may exert chosen opposing character with less {S} than them.

coconut-012.name: Moana - Curious Explorer
coconut-012.text: During your turn, if you have a Moana, Heihei, or Pua character in play, you may ink an additional card.

coconut-013.name: John Silver - Greedy Treasure Seeker
coconut-013.text: Each of your locations gains Resist +1 for each character there.

coconut-014.name: Robin Hood - Sneaky Sleuth
coconut-014.text: At the start of your first turn, you may play an item card named Robin's Bow from your collection for free.\n\nWhenever you play a character named Robin Hood, deal 1 damage to chosen opposing character or location.

coconut-015.name: Tinker Bell - Giant Fairy
coconut-015.text: Whenever one of your other abilities or actions deals damage to an opposing character, deal 1 damage to that character.

coconut-016.name: Sisu - Emboldened Warrior
coconut-016.text: All characters with more {S} than each opposing character can quest the turn they're played.

coconut-017.name: Pocahontas - Peacekeeper
coconut-017.text: Once during your turn, you may choose a character. Until the start of your next turn, they get +1 {L} and can't challenge and must quest if able.

coconut-018.name: Dumbo - Ninth Wonder of the Universe
coconut-018.text: You may use the {E} abilities of your characters the turn they're played.
coconut-018.associated_card: Dumbo - Ninth Wonder of the Universe

coconut-019.name: Woody & Buzz Lightyear - Best Buddies
coconut-019.text: Once during your turn, you may pay 1 {I} less for the next Toy character you play this turn. If you do and you have a character named Woody and a character named Buzz Lightyear in play, draw a card.

coconut-020.name: Belle & Beast - Certain as the Sun
coconut-020.text: Whenever one of your characters with cost 5 or more readies, draw a card.
coconut-020.associated_card: Belle & Beast - Certain as the Sun

coconut-021.name: Peter Pan & Tinker Bell - Fast Friends
coconut-021.text: Once during your turn, you may give chosen character Evasive until the start of your next turn. If they already had Evasive, they get +1 {L} until the start of your next turn.
coconut-021.associated_card: Peter Pan & Tinker Bell - Fast Friends

coconut-022.name: The Madrigal Family - Every Generation
coconut-022.text: During your turn, whenever you remove 1 or more damage from one of your characters, you may ready them. They can't quest or challenge for the rest of this turn.

coconut-023.name: Aladdin & Genie - Mischievous Pals
coconut-023.text: Whenever you draw a card during your turn, if it's the third card you drew this turn, gain 2 lore.

coconut-024.name: The Vine - Towering Stalk
coconut-024.text: Once during your turn, for each Floodborn character you have in play, you may pay 1 {I} less for the next Floodborn character you play this turn.

coconut-025.name: Darkwing Duck & Launchpad - St. Canard's Finest
coconut-025.text: During your turn, whenever an opposing character is banished in a challenge, gain 1 lore. If they were a Villain character, gain 3 lore instead.
coconut-025.associated_card: Darkwing Duck & Launchpad - St. Canard's Finest
